title: The Taking leads switch
end_headline: On when you're in. Off when you're out.

say: Busy, or on leave? Here's how to pause new leads.
Busy हैं, या छुट्टी पे? New leads ऐसे pause कीजिए.
caption: Busy hain, ya chhutti pe? New leads aise pause kijiye.

say: Busy आहात, किंवा सुट्टीवर? New leads असे pause करा.
caption: Busy aahat, kinva suttivar? New leads ase pause kara.

say: On Leads, this green chip says Taking leads.
While it's on, new leads can come to you.
Leads पे ये green chip दिखता है, Taking leads.
जब तक ये on है, new leads आपके पास आ सकते हैं.
caption: Leads pe yeh green chip dikhta hai, Taking leads.
Jab tak yeh on hai, new leads aapke paas aa sakte hain.

say: Leads वर हा green chip दिसतो, Taking leads.
हा on असेपर्यंत, new leads तुमच्याकडे येऊ शकतात.
caption: Leads var ha green chip disto, Taking leads.
Ha on asepparyant, new leads tumchyakade yeu shaktat.

say: New leads go to other sellers, and your open leads and follow-ups stay with you.
Pause करने के लिए इसपे tap कीजिए.
New leads बाकी sellers को जाते हैं, और आपके open leads और follow-ups आपके पास ही रहते हैं.
caption: Pause karne ke liye ispe tap kijiye.
New leads baaki sellers ko jaate hain, aur aapke open leads aur follow-ups aapke paas hi rehte hain.

say: New leads बाकीच्या sellers कडे जातात, आणि तुमचे open leads आणि follow-ups तुमच्याकडेच राहतात.
caption: Pause karayla yavar tap kara.
New leads baakichya sellers kade jaatat, aani tumche open leads aani follow-ups tumchyakadech rahtat.

say: Back at work? Turn it on again, from Leads or from Settings, Selling.
वापस काम पे? Leads से या Settings, Selling से, फिर से on कर दीजिए.
caption: Waapas kaam pe? Leads se ya Settings, Selling se, phir se on kar dijiye.

say: परत कामावर? Leads मधून किंवा Settings, Selling मधून, परत on करा.
caption: Parat kamavar? Leads madhun kinva Settings, Selling madhun, parat on kara.
